verdict.rationale: Hatchet has dedicated self-hosting documentation describing running your own Control Plane instance, is open-source on GitHub (Postgres-backed, no proprietary lock-in), and community discussion confirms real-world self-hosted deployments (e.g., users comparing it to Celery/RabbitMQ, discussing self-host quirks like broken quickstart links). missing for 10: independent third-party write-up of a full self-hosted production deployment and more detail on self-host resource/ops requirements beyond the docs page.
